fieldValues.title: type.json: identityFieldId description delivered; srs-rust#868 re-tested stale
fieldValues.summary: Added Type.identityFieldId's promised description (RFC-020 Rev 1) to docs/schema/2.0/type.json and the metamodel record, via a new per-assignment `emit` opt-in flag in gen-metamodel-package.mjs rather than flipping the whole parked FieldAssignment.description gate. RFC-020 Rev 7 (srs#728) had marked this class blocked by srs-rust#868 (additionalProperties:false on FieldAssignment in the pinned binary's embedded schema); empirically re-tested against the currently pinned build (v0.1.0-build.365) and it round-trips clean.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs gate:dispatched queue via srs#580 tick 2026-09-10 ~19:20Z. Executes what accepted RFC-020 already specifies (schema-changes table row, unfulfilled since Revision 1); Door 1, no new normative meaning. Ground: read #734's body + owner addendum (comment 5620756432) instructing the metamodel record be fixed too, via CLI not by hand. Charter: RFC-020's own Rev 7 history row (added the same day) claimed this was blocked by srs-rust#868 for builds .284-.294; re-tested against the current pin (.365) by round-tripping the type Type's identity_field_id FieldAssignment through `srs type update` + `srs repo validate --repo srs` -- loads clean, 0 errors, 12 pre-existing warnings, unchanged. Work: added a narrow, opt-in `emit` flag per FieldAssignment in gen-metamodel-package.mjs (default false) rather than flipping the whole parked-description gate wholesale, flipped it on only for this one verified case, regenerated the metamodel package + generated-type-reference table + RFC-035 goldens + docs/spec/**, hand-edited the frozen type.json seed to match byte-for-byte (key order: description before title, matching schema-emitter.mjs's emitBody order). Also fixed 3 newly-surfaced spec-language violations (em-dash-cap digest shift, 2x keyword-register on MUST) in the one changed generated-type-reference paragraph, citing the existing corpus-wide srs#563 debt bucket rather than inventing a new one; left 32 unrelated pre-existing stale allowlist entries untouched. Both gates green by real exit code (not `| tail`), plus check-idl-schema-conformance.mjs, check-schema-regenerate-drift.mjs, tests/rfc-035/run.mjs. Filed srs-vscode#114 for the schema mirror. PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/740 (auto-merge armed, gate:auto-merge).
